管理 1500 ft 航线高度和着陆构型: Manage 1500 ft circuit altitude and landing configuration
管理可达性，按时机放轮与襟翼: Manage glide range and gear/flap timing
管理有限的高度与速度，滑翔至跑道。: Manage limited altitude and speed to glide to the runway.
约 180 ft 左发失效。C 确认并保持操纵，保持跑道方向爬升，1100 ft: The left engine fails near 180 ft. Acknowledge with C and maintain control. Climb on runway heading, then follow ND left over the coast above 1100 ft. Circuit altitude is 1500 ft. The fault persists through landing; left reverse is unavailable. Rudder assistance defaults on; A can assist the route.
约 2 km · F 放至 CONF 1，目标 165 kt: Near 2 km · F select CONF 1, target 165 kt

脱离后返场着陆，制动至停稳: Return after escape, land and brake to a full stop
自动推力不可用 · 手动管理复飞速度，按 FD 爬升: A/THR unavailable · Control go-around speed manually and follow FD climb
襟翼卡阻，保持实际构型并按新目标速度进近: Flaps jammed; retain actual configuration and use revised approach speed
触地复飞 · 1100 ft 已通过，按 FD 左转海侧继续爬升: TOUCH AND GO · Above 1100 ft, follow FD left over coast and continue climb
触地复飞 · TOGA 加速，保持中线，125 kt 后再抬轮: TOUCH AND GO · TOGA, accelerate on centerline, rotate above 125 kt

触地复飞 · 松开空格 / 刹车按钮，保持跑道方向: TOUCH AND GO · Release Space / brake button, maintain runway heading
识别信号失效并接管: Recognize signal loss and take control
识别双发失效并保持滑翔速度: Identify dual failure, maintain glide speed
识别失效，建立稳定单发爬升: Identify failure and establish stable single-engine climb
识别引导丢失，最终完成目视着陆。: Recognize guidance loss and complete a visual landing.
请识别并确认本关故障后完成任务。: Identify and acknowledge this lesson's fault before completing the task.
起落架三绿灯 / 实际着陆构型: Gear three green / Actual landing configuration
起飞后失效，使用剩余动力返场落地。: Handle an engine failure after takeoff and return on remaining power.
起飞后正爬升收轮，300 ft 后 L 选择 CL。按 ND 左转至海侧五段训练: Retract gear after positive climb; select CL with L above 300 ft. Follow ND left over the coast through the five circuit legs, maintaining 1500 ft. Avoid continuing toward inland hills. A is optional. Extend flaps downwind, lower gear and complete checks on base, then land manually on final.
跟随横向指引，截获航向道: Follow lateral guidance to capture localizer
转向对正、减速并完成着陆构型: Turn to align, slow down and configure for landing
轻按 ↓ 拉平 · 推力收到 IDLE: Gently pull ↓ to flare · Thrust to IDLE
轻柔拉平并在跑道接地: Flare gently and touch down on runway
达到起飞速度 · 按 ↓ 后拉至约 12°: Rotation speed · Pull back with ↓ to about 12°
迎角接近上限 · 减小后拉，注意速度: Angle of attack near limit · Reduce aft input, monitor speed
返场三边 · F 放至 CONF 2，按航线减速: Return downwind · F select CONF 2, slow for route
返场四边 · G 放轮，F 完成着陆构型，B / M / C 检查: Return base · G gear down, F landing flaps, B / M / C checks
进入三边 · F 放至 CONF 2，按航线减速: Downwind · F select CONF 2, slow for route
进近中 LOC / G/S 信号丢失，AP 断开，FD 不再提供失效的 ILS: LOC / G/S signals fail during approach. AP disconnects and FD no longer provides invalid ILS guidance. Acknowledge with C, then align and land visually, or T go around and follow the coastal return for a visual landing. A go-around does not finish the lesson; I cannot restore the signals.
进近中自动推力失效。C 确认后，将推力杆移到提示的匹配位置，解除 THR LK，: Autothrust fails during approach. Acknowledge with C, move the lever to the displayed matching position to release THR LK, then use W / S to maintain speed manually and land. U cannot repair the failure.
选择 CL 档 · A/THR 控速，继续爬升: Select CL · A/THR controls speed, continue climb
选择 F 后识别襟翼卡阻: Request F, then identify flap jam
速度偏高 · L 选择 CL，让 A/THR 减速: SPEED HIGH · L select CL, let A/THR slow down
速度偏高 · S 收小剩余推力，减速至 230 kt 以下: SPEED HIGH · S reduce remaining thrust, slow below 230 kt
速度偏高 · S 收小推力，保持稳定爬升: SPEED HIGH · S reduce thrust, maintain stable climb
雨雾遮挡跑道。任务决断高度为 200 ft；未建立目视参考时，T 复飞至 300: Rain and fog obscure the runway. Lesson decision height is 200 ft. Without visual reference, T go around to 3000 ft. Follow the ND coastal return as weather gradually improves; establish visual conditions, land and stop. Going around alone does not complete the lesson.
需要再次起飞时按 T，松开刹车后加速抬轮。: To take off again, press T, release brakes, accelerate and rotate.
需要复飞返场，在恢复目视条件后着陆停稳。: Go around and return, then land and stop after visual conditions improve.
需要按实际 CONF 2 完成着陆检查。: Complete the landing checklist for actual CONF 2.
需要按顺序完成返场航线与着陆检查。: Complete the return route in order and the landing checklist.
